$comment: ButlerOY brand tokens. Machine-readable so the settings UI and tray read the same numbers as the artwork, rather than re-typing hex codes - which is how a palette drifts. Validated by tests/test_brand.py.
name: ButlerOY

tier_colour.$comment: D13's four tiers, as the badge component renders them. A user must be able to see what a call will cost before approving it.

tracking.$comment: em. Small caps need air or they read as shouting.

space.$comment: A 4px grid. Every dimension in the kit is a multiple of 4.

radius.$comment: Three radii and nothing in between: a control, a card, the app plate.

size.$comment: px. Row is the workhorse list height; nothing interactive is under 32.

mark.$comment: The 64-unit grid, mirrored from mark.svg and asserted against it by tests/test_brand.py.

asset.$comment_geometry: The tray renders the mark at runtime from assistant.brand, not from a file - src/ is the only directory pyproject packages, so a PNG here would not exist for an installed user. render_icons.py is a thin CLI over that module. tests/test_brand.py asserts all three copies agree.
